name: file.write
description: Write content to a file. Atomic by default — content lands in a temp file then renames into place. Overwrites existing files; classified U.

path.description: Absolute path. Parent directory must exist (use file.mkdir first).

content.description: Content to write. base64-encoded if encoding=binary.

atomic.description: When true, write to a temp file and rename into place. When false, writes directly to path.

create_only.description: If true, fails with ERR already_exists rather than overwriting.

windows-modern.description: CreateFileW + WriteFile to a sibling temp file, then atomic MoveFileExW with MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING.

windows-classic.description: CreateFileA on NT 4 / 9x; CreateFileW on NT 5+. Atomic rename via MoveFileEx (NT 4+). 9x falls back to CopyFile + DeleteFile (non-atomic).
